name: Lavender Sprig

yarn.description: Cotton yarn for clustered lavender buds
Cotton yarn for the covered stem

additional_materials: One 16 cm length of 24-gauge floral wire
gauge: Gauge is not critical because the wire sets the stem length. Keep the covering stitches close together so the wire does not show.

steps.label: Prepare wire
steps.text: Using pliers, bend a tiny hook at each end of the 16 cm floral wire. Press each hook flat so no sharp wire end is exposed.

steps.label: Stem
steps.text: With green yarn, make a slip knot around one hooked wire end. Work 50 sc around the wire, sliding the stitches together as needed to cover the full length. Fasten off, leaving a 10 cm tail.

steps.label: Top band
steps.text: Join lavender yarn with a sl st in the topmost green sc. On each of the next 3 green sc, make 1 bud: ch 3, work dc and hdc in the third ch from hook, sl st in the same green sc, then sl st in the next green sc. Complete this sequence 3 times.

steps.label: Upper band
steps.text: On each of the next 5 green sc, make 2 buds: ch 3, work dc and hdc in the third ch from hook, sl st in the same green sc; make the same bud once more in that green sc; then sl st in the next green sc. Complete this sequence 5 times.

steps.label: Full band
steps.text: On each of the next 6 green sc, make 3 buds: ch 3, work dc and hdc in the third ch from hook, sl st in the same green sc. Make this bud sequence 3 times in that green sc, then sl st in the next green sc. Complete this sequence 6 times.

steps.label: Lower band
steps.text: On each of the next 4 green sc, make 2 buds: ch 3, work dc and hdc in the third ch from hook, sl st in the same green sc; make the same bud once more in that green sc; then sl st in the next green sc. Complete this sequence 4 times.

finishing: Fasten off the lavender yarn after the final sl st, leaving a 10 cm tail.
Weave in the lavender and green yarn tails through nearby stitches on the reverse side of the sprig.
Gently pinch and spread the bud clusters around the upper stem for a softly tapered lavender spike.
Bend the wire stem lightly by hand if desired, keeping the budded section upright.
notes: The sprig has 39 small buds: 3 in the top band, 10 in the upper band, 18 in the full band and 8 in the lower band.
Rotate the stem slightly between groups while making buds so the clusters sit around the wire rather than in a flat line.
